title_en: Xu Qin Conducts Research in Jiamusi and Hegang
summary_zh: 4日，省委书记许勤到佳木斯市、鹤岗市调研粮食产能提升重大水利工程建设情况，督导检查防汛抗洪救灾工作，慰问工程建设者和抗洪一线人员。
summary_en: On Aug 4, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, visited Jiamusi and Hegang to inspect major water conservancy projects for grain production capacity, supervise flood control and disaster relief work, and extend condolences to construction workers and frontline flood-fighting personnel.
body_zh:
发布日期：2026-08-05 22:46
4日，省委书记许勤到佳木斯市、鹤岗市调研粮食产能提升重大水利工程建设情况，督导检查防汛抗洪救灾工作，慰问工程建设者和抗洪一线人员。
